title: Competitive Echo: continuous model landscape capture and actionable procurement playbook
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Objective: Create a small, repeatable program (Competitive Echo) that continuously captures signals about open and hosted model availability, pricing/commit changes, latency and quantization compatibility, then translates those signals into prioritized procurement and onboarding recommendations for Dedicated/Private customers.

Why now: Increasing churn and rapid pricing churn among open and hosted model providers means platform teams need a defensible, operationalized signal-to-action flow (not just a spreadsheet). This ticket scopes the MVP: automated signal ingestion, a lightweight scoring model, a prioritization dashboard, and a short runbook that ties signals to specific playbook actions (e.g., pre-provision Dedicated capacity, trigger quantization compatibility testing, notify sales/solutions).

Deliverables (MVP):
- Ingest pipeline for 6 signals: model availability (versions/variants), public pricing or observed token price, measured p95 regional latency (synthetic probes), quantization compatibility metadata, reported SLA/uptime incidents, and observed API contract changes.
- A 3-factor prioritization scorer (customer exposure x outage probability x migration cost proxy) with configurable thresholds.
- Dashboards: time-series of availability & price volatility, prioritized model watchlist, and a per-customer impact estimator (coarse).
- Procurement runbook: explicit triage steps for high/medium/low alerts, ownership matrix (PM/Eng/Sales/SRE), and a checklist for provisioning Dedicated capacity or Private packaging.
- Prototype alerts wired into Slack + Create Linear tickets with templated remediation items.

Scope & constraints:
- Start with top 40 models we track in the catalog and 3 major cloud regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1).
- Use synthetic probes from our monitoring infra where possible; fallback to third-party latency measurement for hosted-only providers.
- Initial scoring uses heuristic weights; later iterations will incorporate customer telemetry and ML-based probability estimates.

Success criteria (MVP):
- Signal pipeline successfully refreshes every 6 hours for >90% of tracked models.
- Dashboard can surface a high-priority watchlist and create action tickets with pre-filled remediation suggestions.
- Runbook validated by at least two PMs, one solutions engineer, and one SRE in a tabletop exercise.

Owner & stakeholders: Samir Patel (PM owner), Data Eng (ingest), Observability (dashboards), Solutions Eng (customer impact mapping), Partnerships (pricing verification), Sales Ops (alert routing).

Data sources / links: Confluence research notes (doc link pending), model catalog (internal), probe playbook (observability runbook), examples of observed pricing changes and outages (attached in comments).

Acceptance criteria: all deliverables present in staging, automated alerts create Linear tickets using PM-598214 template, a 30-minute tabletop walkthrough completed with stakeholders and documented feedback.
